import mteb

REVISION = "7999e1d3359715c523056ef9478215996d62a620"
QUERY = "terminal-bench"
DATA_PATH = "/app/data.txt"
RESULT_PATH = "/app/result.txt"

model = mteb.get_model(MODEL_NAME, revision=REVISION)
print("Loaded model:", type(model).__name__)
print("Model meta name:", model.mteb_model_meta.name)
print("Model meta revision:", model.mteb_model_meta.revision)

with open(DATA_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    lines = f.read().splitlines()
print(f"Number of documents: {len(lines)}")

query_emb = model.encode([QUERY], normalize_embeddings=True)
doc_embs = model.encode(lines, normalize_embeddings=True)

fifth_idx = order[4]  # 5th highest
result = lines[fifth_idx]

with open(RESULT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(result + "\n")
